notSuites.tests/live/fatalFrame.ts: Shared helper, not a suite. Typed reader for the Worker's fatal socket-rejection frame (parseFatalFrame + onFatalFrame); imported by the live suites, runs no assertions of its own.
notSuites.tests/live/run-live.ts: Integration driver, not a suite. Boots `wrangler dev` and spawns the live-worker suites against it. Owned by `npm run test:integration:worker`.

skip.tests/contracts/server-update-local.ts: Owned by `npm run test:server-update-local`, which runs `build:server-release` first. Needs dist/release-assets/yaos-server.zip on disk and shells out to git in a temp clone.
skip.tests/live/schema-guard.ts: Live-worker suite. Spawned by tests/live/run-live.ts; needs a running server on 127.0.0.1:8787 and SYNC_TOKEN.
skip.tests/live/provider-manual-connect.ts: Live-worker suite. Spawned by tests/live/run-live.ts; exits non-zero without SYNC_TOKEN.
skip.tests/live/sync-client.ts: Live-worker suite. Spawned by tests/live/run-live.ts with positional args (file path, text); needs a running server and SYNC_TOKEN.
skip.tests/live/snapshots.ts: Live-worker suite. Spawned by tests/live/run-live.ts; needs a running server, SYNC_TOKEN, and an R2 binding for snapshot routes.
skip.tests/live/hardening-worker.ts: Live-worker suite. Spawned by tests/live/run-live.ts; needs a running server and SYNC_TOKEN.
skip.tests/live/ws-ticket-reconnect.ts: Live-worker suite. Spawned by tests/live/run-live.ts, which starts the server with YAOS_TICKET_TTL_MS:8000 so post-expiry reconnect is reachable in seconds.
skip.tests/live/ws-admission-protocol.ts: Live-worker suite. Spawned by tests/live/run-live.ts; needs a running server and SYNC_TOKEN.
skip.tests/live/vault-tokens-live.ts: Live-worker suite. Spawned by tests/live/run-live.ts phase 2, which boots a second wrangler dev with SYNC_TOKEN removed; needs an UNCLAIMED server, which it claims itself before minting the per-vault tokens it exercises.
skip.tests/live/strict-permissions-live.ts: Live-worker suite. Spawned by tests/live/run-live.ts phase 3, which boots a third wrangler dev with YAOS_STRICT_PERMISSIONS set, SYNC_TOKEN removed, and inert Cloudflare Access vars so /admin answers 401 rather than 404; asserts the refusal surface only a real deployment can show. Issuance needs a verifiable Access JWT and is covered in-process by tests/server/strict-permissions.ts.
skip.tests/live/live-seed-check.ts: Manual probe against a deployed server. Throws unless YAOS_TEST_HOST, SYNC_TOKEN, and YAOS_TEST_VAULT_ID are all set.
skip.tests/live/persistence-handoff-proof.ts: Issue #24 RCA experiment against a live server. Throws without SYNC_TOKEN; two-device handoff over real WebSockets.
skip.tests/live/persistence-eviction-proof.ts: Issue #24 RCA experiment. Defaults YAOS_TEST_HOST to a real deployment URL and sleeps 160s waiting for Durable Object eviction — far too slow and too external for the regression gate.

serialReason: These suites write into the repo tree, so they must never run concurrently with each other or with a build. The runner is sequential today, which satisfies this for free; the list exists so that adding parallelism cannot silently break it.
